canonical_claim: Let (M_i) be a nonempty linearly ordered increasing chain of structures for one first-order language. If M_i is an elementary substructure of M_j whenever i <= j, then the induced union structure U is an elementary extension of every M_i.
domain_and_universes: One first-order language L; a nonempty linear order I; an I-indexed compatible family of nonempty L-structures and elementary inclusion maps. Exact universe levels and same-carrier-substructure versus typed-direct-system encoding remain open.
quantifiers: nonempty linearly ordered index type I
compatible elementary inclusions M_i to M_j for i <= j
hypotheses: the index order is nonempty and linear
the family is increasing through compatible inclusions
conclusion: The canonical inclusion of each M_i into the induced union structure is elementary.

alternate_encodings.target: a directed family of elementary substructures of one ambient L-structure whose substructure supremum is elementary
alternate_encodings.relationship: intended equivalent presentation after a checked common-ambient/direct-limit transport

alternate_encodings.target: the direct limit of a linearly ordered system of elementary embeddings, with every structure mapping elementarily into the limit

excluded_degenerate_cases: The empty chain is excluded because there is no member whose elementary extension is asserted and its union need not be a nonempty model. Singleton chains are included. No countability, ordinal indexing, finite language, or fixed ambient carrier assumption may be added without a checked transport.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical/choice requirements of the eventual construction and proof remain to be audited
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are candidate components; exact imports, declaration closure, and axiom profile remain open
computation_profile: noncomputable structural theorem expected; no oracle, experiment, or unchecked certificate is intended
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on canonical wording, source edition, chain encoding, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, profile, or validator change; independent review and review due date remain open.
